blocks.zh: 成品預填充注射器的性能、藥品及文件要求
blocks.en: Performance, Drug Product and Documentation Requirements for Finished Prefilled Syringes

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解成品預填充注射器（Finished Prefilled Syringe）的完整定義和監管定位（藥品、組合產品或醫療器械）
blocks.en: Understand the complete definition and regulatory positioning of the finished prefilled syringe (drug, combination product or medical device)

blocks.zh: 掌握用戶需求（User Requirements）分析、風險管理（ISO 14971）和可用性工程（IEC 62366）在設計中的應用
blocks.en: Master the application of user requirements analysis, risk management (ISO 14971) and usability engineering (IEC 62366) in design

blocks.zh: 熟悉成品注射器的系統表徵、功能性能測試（6項）和藥品要求（6項）的完整框架
blocks.en: Become familiar with the complete framework of system characterization, functional performance tests (6 items) and drug product requirements (6 items) for finished syringes

blocks.zh: 認識ISO 11040-8作為「系統性能」標準與前7個部分（組件標準）的互補關係
blocks.en: Recognize the complementary relationship between ISO 11040-8, as the "system performance" standard, and the first seven parts (component standards)

blocks.en: Part 8 Clauses 1–4 — Scope, User Requirements, Risk Management, Usability

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 成品預填充注射器的雙重監管身份：ISO 11040-8的Introduction明確指出，成品預填充注射器需要上市許可（Marketing Authorization）作為藥品、組合產品（Combination Product）或醫療器械，取決於內容物和預期用途。在EU，藥品主導的組合產品按藥品法規（2001/83/EC）審批，並需要符合MDR（EU 2017/745）的相關要求；在美國，依據21 CFR 3.2(e)分類後，由FDA的相關部門（CDER/CDRH/CBER）主導審查。
blocks.en: Dual regulatory identity of the finished prefilled syringe: The Introduction of ISO 11040-8 states that a finished prefilled syringe requires a marketing authorization as a drug, a combination product or a medical device, depending on the contents and intended use. In the EU, drug-led combination products are approved under the medicinal products legislation (2001/83/EC) and must also meet the relevant requirements of the MDR (EU 2017/745); in the US, after classification under 21 CFR 3.2(e), the review is led by the relevant FDA center (CDER/CDRH/CBER).

blocks.zh: ISO 14971（醫療器械風險管理）：要求對整個生命周期的風險進行系統識別、評估、控制和監控。對預填充注射器而言，風險評估需覆蓋：(1) 容器-藥品相互作用（如矽油與蛋白質的相互作用）；(2) 使用錯誤（Use Error）——患者在家庭環境中的操作失誤；(3) 製造工藝風險（如終端滅菌對密封性的影響）。
blocks.en: ISO 14971 (risk management for medical devices): Requires systematic identification, evaluation, control and monitoring of risks across the whole life cycle. For prefilled syringes, the risk assessment must cover: (1) container-drug interactions (such as the interaction between silicone oil and proteins); (2) use error, i.e. patient handling mistakes in the home environment; (3) manufacturing process risks (such as the effect of terminal sterilization on seal integrity).

blocks.zh: IEC 62366（可用性工程）：要求在設計過程中系統評估預期用戶在預期使用環境下的操作能力。對帶有自動注射裝置的預填充注射器（如pen-injector），必須進行形成性（Formative）和總結性（Summative）可用性研究，確認用戶能夠安全正確地使用產品。
blocks.en: IEC 62366 (usability engineering): Requires systematic evaluation, during design, of the ability of intended users to operate the product in the intended use environment. For prefilled syringes with an autoinjector device (such as a pen-injector), formative and summative usability studies must be performed to confirm that users can use the product safely and correctly.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: ISO 11040-8就像一輛完整汽車的驗收標準，而Parts 1–7是各個零部件（引擎、輪胎、方向盤）的規格。零部件各自符合標準，不代表整車能安全行駛——需要系統性的整車功能測試（剎車性能、轉向靈敏度等），就像ISO 11040-8對成品預填充注射器進行系統功能性能測試（啟動力、爆破壓力、密封完整性等）。
blocks.en: ISO 11040-8 is like the acceptance standard for a complete car, while Parts 1–7 are the specifications for the individual components (engine, tires, steering wheel). Components that each meet their standards do not mean the whole car can be driven safely; systematic whole-vehicle functional testing (braking performance, steering responsiveness and so on) is needed, just as ISO 11040-8 requires systematic functional performance testing of the finished prefilled syringe (break-loose force, burst pressure, seal integrity and so on).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 製造商定義的廣泛性：ISO 11040-8對「製造商」的定義是「持有藥品上市許可的法人」，而非「生產設施的所有者」。這意味著即使CDMO代工生產，最終責任仍在藥品持有人（MAH）。CDMO與MAH之間的責任劃分應在質量協議（Quality Agreement）中明確規定。
blocks.en: Broad definition of manufacturer: ISO 11040-8 defines the "manufacturer" as "the legal entity holding the marketing authorization for the drug product", not "the owner of the production facility". This means that even when a CDMO performs the manufacturing, final responsibility remains with the marketing authorization holder (MAH). The division of responsibilities between the CDMO and the MAH should be clearly specified in the Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh: 邊界產品的包容性：ISO 11040-8明確將透明質酸（Hyaluronic Acid）等「邊界產品」納入範圍，這些產品有時按醫療器械監管（如關節注射填充劑）。這體現了ISO 11040-8作為「中性框架」的設計意圖——適用於任何預填充注射器，無論監管身份。
blocks.en: Inclusion of borderline products: ISO 11040-8 explicitly brings "borderline products" such as hyaluronic acid into its scope; these are sometimes regulated as medical devices (for example, intra-articular filler injections). This reflects the intent of ISO 11040-8 as a "neutral framework" applicable to any prefilled syringe, regardless of regulatory status.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個CDMO客戶開發了一種用於家庭注射的預填充注射器（含生物製劑）。根據ISO 11040-8第4章，製造商應定義哪些關鍵的「預期使用」要素？這對CDMO的設計確認（Design Qualification）工作有何影響？
blocks.en: A CDMO client has developed a prefilled syringe (containing a biologic) for home injection. According to Clause 4 of ISO 11040-8, which key "intended use" elements should the manufacturer define? What is the impact on the CDMO's design qualification work?

blocks.zh: 為什麼ISO 11040-8強調「風險管理可能導致產品特定的要求和測試方法與本標準不同」？這對ISO 11040-8作為強制性參考標準的地位有何影響？
blocks.en: Why does ISO 11040-8 stress that "risk management may result in product-specific requirements and test methods that differ from this standard"? What does this mean for the status of ISO 11040-8 as a normative reference standard?

blocks.zh: Part 8 Clauses 5–8 — System Characterization, Performance, Pharmaceutical, and Documentation Requirements Part 8 Clauses 5–8 — 系統特性描述、性能、藥學及文件要求
blocks.en: Part 8 Clauses 5–8 — System Characterization, Performance, Pharmaceutical, and Documentation Requirements

blocks.zh: 啟動力與推出力 (Break-Loose Force and Extrusion Force)：
blocks.en: Break-Loose Force and Extrusion Force:

blocks.zh: Break-Loose Force（啟動力）：使活塞塞從靜止狀態開始移動所需的力，通常高於持續推進力。活塞塞在靜態儲存期間（特別是經過終端滅菌後）會與玻璃/矽化層形成一定粘附，導致啟動力增加。
blocks.en: Break-loose force: The force required to start the plunger stopper moving from rest, usually higher than the sustained gliding force. During static storage (especially after terminal sterilization), the plunger stopper develops some adhesion to the glass/silicone layer, which increases the break-loose force.

blocks.zh: Extrusion Force（推出力）：維持活塞塞持續推進所需的力。過高會導致患者無法完成注射；過低意味著密封性不足，可能漏液。
blocks.en: Extrusion force: The force required to keep the plunger stopper moving. If it is too high, the patient cannot complete the injection; if it is too low, the seal may be inadequate and the product may leak.

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性測試 (CCI, Container Closure Integrity)：ISO 11040-8明確要求CCI必須在整個保質期內維持，並推薦使用概率性方法（Probabilistic CCIT，如氦氣洩漏測試、頂空分析、高壓放電測試）而非無菌測試作為主要CCI測試方法，這與USP <1207>的指導原則一致。
blocks.en: Container Closure Integrity (CCI): ISO 11040-8 explicitly requires that CCI be maintained throughout the shelf life, and recommends probabilistic CCI testing methods (such as helium leak testing, headspace analysis and high voltage leak detection) rather than sterility testing as the primary CCI test method, which is consistent with the guidance in USP <1207>.

blocks.zh: 藥品-容器相互作用研究 (Drug-Container Interaction)：必須涵蓋浸出物（Leachables）、吸附（Adsorption，如蛋白質吸附到注射管筒內壁或活塞塞）和降解（Degradation，如藥物被矽油氧化）三個維度。研究條件需包括保質期和儲存溫度的最壞情況（Worst Case）。
blocks.en: Drug-Container Interaction: Studies must cover three dimensions: leachables, adsorption (such as protein adsorption to the inner wall of the syringe barrel or to the plunger stopper) and degradation (such as drug oxidation by silicone oil). Study conditions must include the worst case for shelf life and storage temperature.

blocks.zh: 成品預填充注射器的性能測試就像一輛賽車上賽道前的完整技術檢查：
blocks.en: Performance testing of a finished prefilled syringe is like the full technical inspection of a race car before it goes on the track:

blocks.zh: 啟動力/推出力 = 離合器和油門靈敏度測試
blocks.en: Break-loose/extrusion force = clutch and throttle responsiveness test

blocks.zh: 爆破壓力 = 液壓系統最大承壓測試
blocks.en: Burst pressure = maximum pressure test of the hydraulic system

blocks.zh: CCI = 油箱密封性和氣密性測試
blocks.en: CCI = fuel tank seal and airtightness test

blocks.zh: 藥品-容器相互作用 = 燃料與燃油箱材料的化學相容性測試
blocks.en: Drug-container interaction = chemical compatibility test of the fuel with the fuel tank material

blocks.zh: 可見異物 = 油箱異物（殘渣/顆粒）視覺檢查
blocks.en: Visible particles = visual inspection of the fuel tank for foreign matter (residue/particles)

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌對注射器性能的影響：ISO 11040-8特別指出，終端蒸汽滅菌（Moist Heat Sterilization）可能影響針頭上的矽油層（Clause 6.8 NOTE），並可能增加活塞塞啟動力。因此，性能測試必須在滅菌後的「上市狀態」下進行，而非僅在填充後立即測試。這對CDMO的性能驗證計劃設計至關重要。
blocks.en: Effect of terminal sterilization on syringe performance: ISO 11040-8 specifically notes that terminal steam sterilization (moist heat sterilization) may affect the silicone oil layer on the needle (Clause 6.8 NOTE) and may increase the plunger stopper break-loose force. Performance testing must therefore be carried out on the sterilized syringe in its "as marketed" state, not only immediately after filling. This is critical to the design of the CDMO's performance validation plan.

blocks.zh: 針刺傷防護（Clause 6.10）：ISO 23908要求針刺傷防護功能（Safety Feature）在使用後自動激活，保護醫護人員免受針刺傷。越來越多的監管機構（特別是歐盟和美國）要求帶自動注射裝置的預填充注射器配備這一功能，CDMO在設計評審時需要確認是否符合此要求。
blocks.en: Needlestick injury protection (Clause 6.10): ISO 23908 requires the needlestick protection feature (safety feature) to activate automatically after use to protect healthcare workers from needlestick injuries. More and more regulators (especially in the EU and US) require prefilled syringes with an autoinjector device to be equipped with this feature, and the CDMO needs to confirm compliance with this requirement during design review.

blocks.zh: CCI測試方法選擇的重要性：ISO 11040-8明確指出CCI應由在保質期內經驗證的測試方法確認，並偏好確定性（Deterministic）方法（如氦氣洩漏、高壓放電）而非概率性的無菌測試。這與USP <1207>於2016年的更新方向一致。CDMO在CCI驗證方案設計時，應優先考慮確定性方法，並建立靈敏度（Sensitivity）和特異性（Specificity）的可接受標準。
blocks.en: Importance of choosing the CCI test method: ISO 11040-8 states that CCI should be confirmed by a test method validated over the shelf life, and prefers deterministic methods (such as helium leak and high voltage leak detection) over probabilistic sterility testing. This is consistent with the direction of the 2016 update of USP <1207>. When designing the CCI validation protocol, the CDMO should give priority to deterministic methods and establish acceptance criteria for sensitivity and specificity.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO在承接預填充注射器成品放行批的驗證工作時，應基於ISO 11040-8建立完整的成品規格書（Finished Product Specification），至少包含以下測試項目及驗收標準：(1) 外觀和可見異物；(2) 裝量偏差（Fill Volume Accuracy）；(3) 亞可見異物（HIAC法或膜過濾法）；(4) 無菌測試；(5) 內毒素；(6) 啟動力/推出力（加速穩定性各時間點）；(7) 容器密封完整性（CCI，確定性方法優先）；(8) 藥品特異性的相容性指標（如蛋白質含量、純度、力價）。這些測試項目的驗收標準應基於ICH Q6A/Q6B（生物製劑）和ISO 11040-8的要求共同建立。
blocks.en: When taking on validation work for the release batch of a finished prefilled syringe, a CDMO should establish a complete Finished Product Specification based on ISO 11040-8, containing at least the following tests and acceptance criteria: (1) appearance and visible particles; (2) fill volume accuracy; (3) subvisible particles (HIAC or membrane filtration method); (4) sterility test; (5) endotoxin; (6) break-loose/extrusion force (at each time point of the accelerated stability study); (7) container closure integrity (CCI, deterministic methods preferred); (8) product-specific compatibility indicators (such as protein content, purity and potency). The acceptance criteria for these tests should be established jointly on the basis of ICH Q6A/Q6B (biologics) and the requirements of ISO 11040-8.

blocks.zh: 一個CDMO在承接某單抗預填充注射器的商業化生產。該注射器的保質期為24個月（2-8°C冷藏）。根據ISO 11040-8第6章，至少需要在哪些穩定性時間點進行啟動力/推出力測試？測試時使用哪種溫度的藥液？
blocks.en: A CDMO is taking on commercial production of a monoclonal antibody prefilled syringe. The syringe has a shelf life of 24 months (refrigerated at 2–8°C). According to Clause 6 of ISO 11040-8, at which stability time points must break-loose/extrusion force testing be performed at a minimum? At what temperature should the test solution be when testing?

blocks.zh: 一個新型預填充注射器設計包含一個集成的針刺傷防護機構（Safety Guard）。根據ISO 11040-8 Clause 6.10，該安全機構的確認測試應符合哪個標準的要求？CDMO在設計確認過程中應關注哪些關鍵性能指標？
blocks.en: A new prefilled syringe design includes an integrated needlestick protection mechanism (safety guard). According to Clause 6.10 of ISO 11040-8, which standard's requirements should the confirmation testing of this safety mechanism meet? Which key performance indicators should the CDMO focus on during design qualification?

blocks.zh: 為什麼ISO 11040-8第7.4條關於CCI測試偏好「確定性方法」而非「無菌測試」？從監管科學（Regulatory Science）的角度解釋這種偏好的合理性。
blocks.en: Why does Clause 7.4 of ISO 11040-8 on CCI testing prefer "deterministic methods" over "sterility testing"? Explain the rationale for this preference from a regulatory science perspective.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: ISO 11040-8是ISO 11040系列的「系統級」標準，涵蓋成品預填充注射器的功能性能（12項）和藥品要求（6項），補充了Parts 1–7的組件級要求
blocks.en: ISO 11040-8 is the "system-level" standard of the ISO 11040 series, covering the functional performance (12 items) and drug product requirements (6 items) of finished prefilled syringes, and complementing the component-level requirements of Parts 1–7

blocks.zh: 風險管理（ISO 14971）和可用性工程（IEC 62366）是成品注射器設計和驗證的核心方法論，所有性能要求和測試方法均可基於風險評估進行調整
blocks.en: Risk management (ISO 14971) and usability engineering (IEC 62366) are the core methodologies for the design and validation of finished syringes; all performance requirements and test methods can be adjusted on the basis of risk assessment

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性（CCI）測試應優先使用確定性方法（如氦氣洩漏），並在保質期全程驗證其維持能力
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCI) testing should preferably use deterministic methods (such as helium leak), and its ability to be maintained should be validated over the entire shelf life

blocks.zh: 藥品-容器相互作用研究需覆蓋浸出物、吸附和降解三個維度，並在保質期最壞情況條件下進行，是商業化上市前最複雜的技術工作之一
blocks.en: Drug-container interaction studies must cover leachables, adsorption and degradation, and be performed under worst-case shelf-life conditions; this is one of the most complex technical tasks before commercial launch
